tools.name: get_product_overview
tools.title: Get product overview
tools.description: Return an overview of ShadowTalk AI: what it is, who built it, the free tier, privacy posture and pricing plans.

includePricing.description: Include the full pricing plan breakdown. Defaults to true.

tools.name: list_features
tools.title: List features
tools.description: List ShadowTalk AI features with their category, in-app route and a short description. Optionally filter by keyword or category.

query.description: Free-text keyword to filter features by name or description.

category.description: Filter by category, e.g. chat, research, security, code, privacy, platform.

tools.name: get_changelog
tools.title: Get changelog
tools.description: Return recent ShadowTalk AI release notes: version, title, summary and the individual changes.

limit.description: How many recent releases to return (1-20, default 5).

tools.name: answer_faq
tools.title: Answer FAQ
tools.description: Search ShadowTalk AI's published FAQ (pricing, accounts, privacy, offline use, supported platforms) and return matching answers.

question.description: The question to look up. Omit to return every FAQ entry.
